# Harley Street Hearing

> > London's largest independent ear clinic providing comprehensive audiology, hearing protection, and specialized ear care services with multilingual support.

Harley Street Hearing is a premium London-based audiology clinic offering private hearing tests, tinnitus therapy, ear wax removal, custom hearing protection, and specialized services for musicians and professionals. The clinic combines clinical expertise with bespoke custom ear products and serves patients in multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Hearing tests and consultations
- Tinnitus therapy
- Ear wax removal
- Custom ear products
- Musicians' hearing protection
- In-ear monitors
- Hearing aids
- Paediatric audiology
- Hearing protection regulations
- Lenire neuromodulation
- Multilingual services
- London audiologists
- Custom ear impressions
- Workplace hearing safety
- Sound therapy

## Core Hearing Services

- [Harley Street Hearing | London Audiologists & Ear Clinic](https://harleysthearing.co.uk): Homepage for London's largest independent ear clinic offering comprehensive hearing solutions
- [Hearing Care | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care): Main hearing care services page covering audiology, tinnitus, ear wax removal and balance diagnostics
- [Private Hearing Tests in London | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/hearing-consultation): Private hearing tests and consultations with qualified clinical audiologists on Harley Street
- [Hearing Tests For Children in London | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/hearing-consultation/hearing-tests-for-children): Paediatric hearing tests for children with age-appropriate assessments and play audiometry
- [Ear Wax Removal | Ear Cleaning in London | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/ear-wax-removal): Same-day ear wax removal using microsuction and irrigation techniques in London

## Tinnitus & Sound Therapy

- [Tinnitus Therapy Clinic London | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/tinnitus-therapy): Professional tinnitus retraining therapy and sound therapy management in London clinic
- [Lenire® Tinnitus Treatment | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/tinnitus-therapy/lenire-tinnitus-treatment): Revolutionary Lenire neuromodulation device for home-based tinnitus treatment

## Custom Ear Products & Hearing Protection

- [Custom Ear Products - Custom Ear Plugs | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products): Custom-made hearing protection for music, work, shooting, swimming and motorcycling
- [In Ear Monitors, Order Your Custom IEM Today](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/in-ear-monitors): Custom in-ear monitors for musicians with ear impressions and wireless audio options
- [Musicians' Ear Plugs | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/musicians-ear-plugs): Custom musicians' ear plugs protecting hearing during performances and loud sound exposure
- [Shooting Ear Protection, Best Ear Plugs for Shooting Online](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/shooting-ear-plugs): Custom shooting ear plugs protecting against gunshot noise exceeding 120 dB
- [Swimming plugs | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/swimming-plugs): Luxury custom-fit swimming earplugs for water sports and ear health protection
- [Earplugs For Sleeping, Noise Cancelling Earplugs For Sleeping](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/earplugs-for-sleeping): Custom-fit sleep earplugs including Ozlo Sleepbuds for noise-blocking comfort
- [Custom Earphones | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/custom-earphones): Custom-fit earphones providing superior sound quality and comfort for individual ears

## Specialized Professional Services

- [Motorbike Pro Communicators | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/motorbike): Custom in-ear communicators for motorbike helmets with Bluetooth and radio capabilities
- [Earpiece and Earmoulds for presenters, TV Earpieces](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/presenter-fittings): Custom earpieces and earmoulds for TV presenters and broadcast professionals

## Multilingual & Accessibility Services

- [Multilingual Hearing Clinic | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/multilingual-hearing-clinic): Multilingual hearing clinic serving patients in Polish, French, Indonesian, Afrikaans and more languages

## Educational Resources & Tools

- [Online Hearing Test | Harley Street Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/online-hearing-test): Free online hearing screening tool to assess hearing health (not replacing professional tests)
- [Hearing Loss From COVID, Effects Of COVID On Hearing](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/hearing-consultation/hearing-loss-covid-19): Information about hearing loss related to COVID-19 infection and vaccination effects
- [Noise At Work Regulations, Avoiding Exposure To Noise](https://harleysthearing.co.uk/hearing-care/custom-ear-products/noise-at-work): Guide to UK Noise at Work Regulations 2005 and workplace hearing protection requirements
